messages.author: bb2081cebf8f7c8c
messages.subject: CFA with runMI error
parts:
Hello, I am trying to run a CFA with MI (via Amelia). But I am getting this error (my data was imported using read.delim).

Amelia Error Code: 30
The frontend setting is not a logical (TRUE/FALSE) value.
Error in (function (model = NULL, dataList = NULL, dataFunction = NULL, :
lavaan ERROR: (generated) data is not a data.frame (or a matrix)

Here is my code:

#Model

CUT_W1 <-'

CUT_W1 =~ NA* CU1_W1 + CU2_W1 + CU3_W1 + CU4_W1

CUT_W1 ~~ 1* CUT_W1

CU1_W1 ~~ CU4_W1'

#MI

outCUT_W1 <- runMI(CUT_W1, data = mTBI_SEM_Data, m=5, fun = "cfa", miArgs = list(ords = "Sex", "Ethnicity", "Neighborhood_SES", "PC_EDU", "HI_Bi_B21"), miPackage = "Amelia", seed = 9876)

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: CFA with runMI error
parts:
Hi Brandon,

That's an Amelia error that's being passed through runMI. What I'd recommend is first imputing your data and then passing the imputed data along to runMI (or cfa.mi etc.). This can help you diagnose the error from Amelia.

Alex

messages.subject: Re: CFA with runMI error
parts:
Thank you for your suggestion, I found my (coding) error. 

This:
miArgs = list(ords = “var1”, “var2”, “var3”)

Needed to be this:

miArgs = list(ords = c( “var1”, “var2”, “var3”))
